1.web: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
1.asv: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!

2.web: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
2.asv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.

3.web: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
3.asv: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.

4.web: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
4.asv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. [Selah

5.web: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
5.asv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways to Zion.

6.web: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
6.asv: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.

7.web: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.
7.asv: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

8.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
8.asv: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. [Selah

9.web: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
9.asv: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.

10.web: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
10.asv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

11.web: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
11.asv: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

12.web: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
12.asv: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
